title: PRIMARY BUILD TARGET
business_purpose: Payroll/expense-item processing and related employee payroll changes
why_selected: pi is the largest family by both workload and time: 209/540 segments (38.7%) and 35.8% of total segment time. It also has pervasive mechanical activity (100%), frequent clipboard transfer (88.0%), and frequent browser interaction (90.0%). The opportunity is large enough to justify first build, while the 34.45% decision-point evidence means the build must retain a human gate.
rollout_recommendation: Automate repetitive retrieval, copy/transfer, transformation, structured form entry, predictable navigation, document preparation, and submission preparation. Keep approval/hold/review/exception decisions human.

title: SECOND OPPORTUNITY
why_selected: la has 99/540 segments (18.3%) but consumes 24.2% of total segment time, with 100% mechanical activity, 93.9% clipboard activity, and 92.9% browser interaction. It is the strongest follow-on opportunity once the pi pilot proves the reusable automation pattern.
rollout_recommendation: Reuse the validated automation pattern for repetitive attendance/leave transfer and form-entry work, while retaining human review and exception handling.
